answer_1.quote: We formulate register allocation as an end-to-end sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) translation task for LLM... VERILOCC fine-tunes an LLM to translate MIR into target-specific register assignments...
answer_1.outputs: JSON-formatted register assignment dictionaries mapping virtual to physical registers

answer_2.quote: Our primary metric is the Pass Rate, which measures the percentage of single-shot greedy decoding generations that pass the verification... We also report Pass@100, the proportion of test cases where at least one valid allocation is generated within 100 attempts.
